title: Ads Video Editor for an e-Commerce Brand (US-based/Remote)
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 4 skills: facebook, instagram, tiktok, youtube. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview: Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located. A fast-growing beauty-meets-science brand transforming the way people experience their daily shower. Our dermatologist-recommended, high-filtration shower technology helps people achieve healthier hair and skin while protecting against the hidden contaminants in tap water. We're looking for a Senior Video Editor who lives and breathes social-first storytelling, thrives in a high-growth environment, and knows how to turn performance data into scroll-stopping creative that converts. Responsibilities: Edit a wide range of performance-driven video content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and occasional high-visibility campaigns. Work across vertical short-form ads and horizontal long-form pieces. Collaborate with our Creative Director and marketing team to concept, refine, and deliver assets optimized for engagement, click-through, and conversion. Incorporate performance feedback into rapid creative iterations. Elevate raw footage with expert color grading, sound design, and motion graphics to match the Eskiin brand aesthetic. Requirements We're not looking for someone who just edits videos-we're looking for a performance-minded creative partner. You should be able to take a general concept plus a dump of raw b-roll files and turn it into strong, fast-paced, high-performing direct response ads without needing a detailed shot-by-shot brief. You should have a deep understanding of direct response creative, performance marketing, and e-commerce ads, and be able to: Self-start and take a concept from idea to final export with minimal hand-holding. Confidently choose the right clips, music, sound effects, captions, and pacing for maximum impact. Required Skills: Proven experience editing high-performing social ads (portfolio required). Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects; bonus points for DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro. Strong understanding of platform-specific trends, pacing, and storytelling styles.
